name: synthetic RAW replacement gate
aggregation: arithmetic mean of 64 paired case scores per probe; every applicable probe/score must improve
regression_scopes: every reconstruction scope of every characterization case
interpretation: Provisional engineering targets fixed before candidate evaluation. Impulse/aliasing remain information-losing characterization with regression caps, not exact-recovery gates. Synthetic acceptance does not certify representative-camera, perceptual, Adobe or production quality.
